summary: Tested interactive clickable recipe cards with detailed recipe view. Found and fixed a critical bug in RecipeDetailModal.js where generateDetailedRecipe was called before null check, causing 'Cannot read properties of null (reading title)' error. Also improved recipe title parsing to skip 'Cuisine' labels. All modal features verified working: hero image, ingredients with checkboxes, step-by-step instructions, nutrition info, chef tips, pairings, storage, star rating, action buttons, and servings adjuster.

issues: Recipe titles sometimes show as 'Cuisine' instead of actual recipe names due to AI response format parsing - improved skip patterns but may still occur with certain AI responses

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: RecipeDetailModal.js - generateDetailedRecipe was called before null check on recipe prop, causing runtime error. Fixed by adding conditional: recipe ? generateDetailedRecipe(recipe) : null
IMPROVED: RecipeMessageDisplay.js - Added 'cuisine' to skip patterns to prevent 'Cuisine' labels from being parsed as recipe titles

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All recipe card and detail modal features working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipe card click and detail modal features are fully functional after bug fix. Flow: 1) User sends mood message -> 2) System asks for food preference -> 3) User clicks preference -> 4) AI generates recipes displayed as visual cards -> 5) User clicks card -> 6) RecipeDetailModal opens with full recipe details. MOCKED: Recipe details (ingredients, instructions, nutrition) are generated from templates in RecipeDetailModal.js based on recipe type (salad, curry, pasta, stir_fry, soup, default). Images use curated static Unsplash URLs.
mocked_api_note: MOCKED: Recipe details (ingredients, instructions, nutrition) generated from templates in RecipeDetailModal.js. Recipe images use hardcoded curated Unsplash URLs in RecipeMessageDisplay.js

bugs_fixed.issue: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'title') at generateDetailedRecipe
bugs_fixed.root_cause: generateDetailedRecipe(recipe) was called at component initialization before the null check (if (!recipe) return null)
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to conditional: const detailedRecipe = recipe ? generateDetailedRecipe(recipe) : null

bugs_fixed.issue: Recipe titles showing as 'Cuisine' instead of actual recipe names
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Skip patterns didn't include standalone 'cuisine' keyword
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'cuisine' to skip patterns in both parseRecipesFromSection and parseRecipesGeneral functions
